Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to engage Myanmar in stages after years of excluding its leaders from high-level meetings. The bloc says Myanmar could regain full representation if it makes progress on a peace plan. (DW)

pyongyang.title: Trump heads to Asia for historic nuclear talks with China and Russia
detail: South Korea fears that nuclear arms talks this week between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese and Russian counterparts could undermine efforts to denuclearise North Korea, potentially leaving Seoul sidelined in decisions affecting its own security. (South China Morning Post)

US President Donald Trump headed to Asia on Monday for economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on nuclear issues and the war in Ukraine. Trump also raised the possibility of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during his visit. (France 24)

pyongyang.title: Trump says he could meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in China
detail: Trump is planning to discuss nuclear disarmament when he meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China this week. (Euronews)

President Donald Trump says he could meet with North Korea's Kim Jong Un while visiting China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Trump spoke to reporters on Monday morning before leaving. (Source: Bloomberg) (Bloomberg)

pyongyang.title: N. Korean leader’s close aide visits Russia amid deepening ties
detail: A North Korean official considered to be one of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s closest aides has arrived in Russia, the North’s state media said Sunday, amid deepening relations between the two countries following North Korea’s deployment of troops to support Russia’s war against Ukraine. (Inquirer)

pyongyang.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
detail: More than 900 victims are thought to have fallen prey to the FaceStealer scheme in the last 18 months. (BBC News)

The US has seized servers linked to a North Korean scam that used fake video meetings and deepfakes to steal more than $400 million in crypto, and has moved to seize $1.2 billion that was taken from Binance. (DW)

pyongyang.title: China, South Korea vow to deepen ties at Apec summit as Seoul pushes North Korea talks
detail: North Korea is unlikely to attend the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit set to be held in China next week, a South Korean presidential official said Thursday. (Inquirer)
China and South Korea have agreed to use next week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen to advance bilateral ties, according to their top diplomats. (South China Morning Post)

pyongyang.title: How South Korea can curb Pyongyang’s job scams in Laos, weapons programmes
detail: South Korea should use its growing economic clout over Laos to crack down on Pyongyang’s IT workers allegedly using the Southeast Asian nation as a base to secure remote jobs under false identities and funnel earnings to their regime’s weapons programmes, according to analysts. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore seeks US talks on AI chip export rules amid Nvidia fallout, Megaspeed probe
detail: Singapore has been engaging with the United States to explore ways to facilitate “trusted access” for local firms after Washington announced a new measure that would restrict exports of artificial intelligence chips to the city state. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: As fears over Western finance grow, could Hong Kong and Singapore win the world’s gold?
detail: Global ultra-rich investors should diversify their physical gold holdings into Asian vault centres such as Hong Kong and Singapore to hedge against risks in Western financial markets, according to Jupiter Asset Management. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Hong Kong man arrested at Singapore’s Changi Airport over alleged shop theft
detail: A 38-year-old Hong Kong man was arrested on arrival in Singapore in October after he allegedly stole earbuds from a store in Changi Airport before leaving the city state nearly three months earlier. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore agrees to continue discussions with US on Megaspeed case
detail: Singapore’s government said on Monday it had agreed to continue discussions with the ‌United States about Megaspeed, the company at the centre of the Nvidia scandal. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore PM Wong earns ‘cool points’ for using viral Filipino song
detail: MANILA, Philippines — Is Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong a fan of OPM (original Pilipino music)? Filipino netizens are asking after the Singaporean leader used Grizzy Bub’s viral track “Dito ang Tingin” in a social media video of his arrival in Manila for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)… (Inquirer)

singapore.title: Asean must deepen integration to navigate uncertain world – Singapore PM
detail: MANILA, Philippines – Asean can expect more turbulence and storms ahead in an increasingly uncertain world, but as long as the grouping remains cohesive and united, it can navigate its path forward and emerge stronger, said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong on Nov 15. (Inquirer)

singapore.title: Singapore PM calls for setting up of regional platform to tackle haze
detail: MANILA, Philippines – Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong on Nov 15 called on Asean to set up a regional platform to coordinate and share information on companies behind fires that cause transboundary haze. (Inquirer)

singapore.title: Princess Aiko to leave for Singapore
detail: It will be her second official overseas visit, after her trip to Laos last year. (The Japan Times)

wellington.title: India, England, Australia and New Zealand to host all ICC events from 2028-31
detail: LAHORE: Pakistan failed to get any event of the International Cricket Council (ICC) at least till 2031, as the game’s world governing body announced its activity programme for the 2028-2035 cycle on Sunday. (Dawn)

wellington.title: Australia crush New Zealand to win fourth Women’s Rugby League World Cup
detail: It's been more than 100 years since Awhina and Rita's ancestors travelled from the rugby league fields of New Zealand to Australia. (ABC News (AU))
Australia dominated the first half and capitalised on the Kiwi Ferns’ errors to win 34-10 and clinch the trophy. (Al Jazeera)

wellington.title: Henry takes six as New Zealand thrash India by 244 runs
detail: Matt Henry took six wickets and Will Young struck a century as New Zealand thrashed a ragged India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui on Friday. (Dawn)

wellington.title: Finance Post Tests New Zealand’s Coalition
detail: Luxon says National keeps the finance post and ACT's Seymour disagrees, while special votes due 27 November decide the coalition's majority. The post Finance Post Tests New Zealand’s Coalition appeared first on The Rio Times . (Rio Times)

wellington.title: New Zealand workers say AI tracking of toilet breaks forces them to ‘hold on’
detail: Workers at New Zealand’s largest retailer have had to resort to defecating in the distribution aisles after their bathroom breaks were tracked by artificial intelligence, their union has claimed. (South China Morning Post)

kathmandu.title: Why did Nepal’s mountain agenda stall at COP31?
detail: KATHMANDU — Nepal went to COP31 with the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli floods behind it and a plain ask: give mountains a permanent place in the UN climate talks. On October 29, Nepal and Bhutan jointly proposed a COP31 agenda item on “1.5°C warming in mountains”. It did not make the formal agenda. (Inquirer)

kathmandu.title: Indian Railways to connect Nepal’s Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya through weekly train service
detail: The train will have stoppages at Jaynagar, Madhubani, Shisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, and Ayodhya Dham, besides its terminal stations (The Hindu)

kathmandu.title: Nepal’s push for Himalayan climate agenda falls short at COP31
detail: Nepal’s diplomatic push to secure a dedicated place for the climate crisis facing the Himalayas and other mountain regions in global climate negotiations has suffered a setback, with its proposal for a separate mountain agenda failing to secure formal recognition at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference… (Inquirer)

kathmandu.title: Rebuild, or relocate? Displaced Nepali families remain in limbo weeks after flood.
detail: Floodwaters destroyed the once-bustling market town of Dhunge. Now, its residents face difficult questions about how – and where – to rebuild. (CS Monitor)

kathmandu.title: Pakistan beat Nepal to set up U-19 Asia Cup semi-final against Bangladesh
detail: Defending champions Pakistan maintained their unbeaten run in the ACC Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026 with a convincing 101-run victory over Nepal at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Muscat on Tuesday. (Dawn)
